caption: The drawing depicts a quilt-like pattern composed of two main sections on a beige background. The upper right section is a square filled with an intricate floral pattern featuring red, pink, and white flowers with green leaves and vines, accented with touches of blue and yellow, all scattered on the beige background. The rest of the composition, surrounding and beneath this square, consists of rows of diamond-shaped segments arranged diagonally. These diamonds create a zigzag or chevron effect and are filled with various small floral and geometric patterns, predominantly in shades of red, pink, blue, green, yellow, and white. The overall layout alternates between densely patterned and relatively plain areas, with the beige background visible in several places, creating a contrast between the richly decorated and empty spaces. The image appears to be a detailed representation of a textile or quilt sample, with visible stitch lines crossing both the floral and geometric sections.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
